draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Mahabaleshwar! The sacred Krishna River begins right here along with five of its tributaries, and under the British this hill town was the summer capital of the Bombay Presidency.
draft.hungryLine: Strawberries are the thing here, so get a strawberry cream, and try the local corn, roasted or boiled, and a vada pav from the vendor by the Hanuman Temple in the main market.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Venna Lake is about a 22 minute walk, and the old temples of Old Mahabaleshwar are 7 km away, where the Krishna Temple marks the river's source.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take a rowing boat out on Venna Lake, or catch the sunset from Bombay Point or Elphinstone Point.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Lodwick Point is named after Peter Lodwick, a British officer who first climbed the hill in April 1824, and his son put up a 25 foot column there that still stands.

spots.name: Venna Lake
spots.detail: 22 min walk · Boat rides and horse rides on a tree-lined lake from 1842

spots.name: Wilson Point

spots.name: Old Mahabaleshwar
spots.detail: 7 km away · The Panchganga, Mahabaleshwar and Krishna temples

legends.title: Where five rivers begin
legends.body: An old Shiva temple in the forest is held to be the source of five rivers, the Krishna among them. The Krishna Temple a few yards from the main complex marks exactly where the river starts.

tips.title: Plan for the monsoon.
tips.body: Paddle boats on Venna Lake stop from June to September, so you'll only get the rowing boats then.

tips.title: Use the restrooms at Mapro Garden.
tips.body: Most of the viewpoints have hardly any restrooms, and clean ones are rare.

story.title: Temples at the source
story.body: The temples of Old Mahabaleshwar date back centuries before colonial times, topped with pyramidal spires. Pilgrims came for the source of the Krishna.

story.title: Battle of Pratapgad
story.body: At Pratapgad fort nearby, the Marathas fought the Sultanate of Bijapur. You can see the fort from Lodwick Point.

story.title: The British find the hills
story.body: Peter Lodwick climbed the hill in April 1824, and Kate's Point is named for the daughter of Governor John Malcolm. In 1842 Shahaji, the last raja of Satara, built Venna Lake.

story.title: Summer capital
story.body: The British developed Mahabaleshwar as a hill station and made it the summer capital of the Bombay Presidency. Wilson Point is named after a 1920s Governor of Bombay.

story.title: Strawberry country
story.body: It's now the largest hill station in the Western Ghats of Maharashtra and a weekend escape from Pune and Mumbai. Strawberry farms and around 25 viewpoints keep people coming.
